tools.name: get_team
tools.description: A club's league position, recent form and next games. For requests like "how are Arsenal doing?", "what's Spurs' form?", "when do Birmingham play next?"

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Upcoming fixtures for a club or a league. For requests like "who do Liverpool play next?" or "what's on in La Liga this weekend?". Without team or league, gives the Premier League.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Latest results for a club, or the last round of a league. For requests like "how did Chelsea get on?" or "what were the Serie A results?". Without team or league, gives the Premier League.

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: League table. For requests like "show me the Championship table" or "who is top of La Liga?". Points include official deductions; a deducted club's row has points_deducted.

tools.name: compare_teams
tools.description: Two clubs side by side before they meet. For requests like "Arsenal v Leeds, how do they compare?". Gives positions, form, goals, this season's meeting and the next date they play. Stats only, not betting advice.
